name: blockers_bristling_boar
note: Bristling Boar: 'This creature can't be blocked by more than one creature.' (CR 509.1b). The first Wall blocks it; the second is then never offered a block (its only legal word would be NONE). Falsified by blockers_bristling_boar_twin, where an ordinary 4/3 is blocked by both. Red on main b02d7fc: the sentence did not parse, so the second Wall was asked and could block too.
